entries.title: PolicyEngine Integration for Export Authorization
entries.resolution: ERR_EXPORT_POLICY_DENIED (9310) added to error_registry.h. ExportOptions extended with collection_name, requesting_user, and policy_engine* fields. enforceExportPolicy() free function implemented in jsonl_llm_exporter.cpp and called at the top of exportEntities() in all 6 exporters (JSONL, HuggingFace, Parquet, ArrowIPC, Streaming, Incremental). EXPORT_DENIED audit event logged with severity MEDIUM on denial; BULK_EXPORT event logged on approval. 10 unit tests in tests/exporters/test_export_encryption.cpp (ExportPolicyEnforcementTest).

entries.title: Hub Direct Upload Integration Not Implemented
entries.resolution: HuggingFaceHubClient implemented in include/exporters/huggingface_hub_client.h + src/exporters/huggingface_hub_client.cpp. Uses libcurl (CURL_ENABLED guard) with retry logic (exponential back-off), 401 Unauthorized surfacing, 413 split-shard hint, and HF_TOKEN env fallback. Registered in cmake/CMakeLists.txt, cmake/ModularBuild.cmake, and tests/CMakeLists.txt (HuggingFaceHubClientFocusedTests).
